instructionSummary:
This app should analyse the image and get meaningful infrom from there using OpenAI. For example, for a audio file it should process the audio file and try to find what is background environment, how many persons are talking background, is it room, washroom, road and similar analysis. similar to audio for images there can be various info such as probable time of the picture by reading the light condition, text info availble in picture with AI context. keep iterating unless you finalise the best versionwhile doing planning. and regenerate the dashboard

Branding colours: SaaS Momentum (#293681, #4274D9, #95CCD0, #DDE7E6). Recommended for dashboard, ai. Use these as brand direction while maintaining accessible text/background contrast.
